description:
This large three bedroom, second floor apartment offers 1292 sq ft (120 sq m) approx of living space, making it an ideal city centre home or investment property.

The apartment boasts stunning views of York’s vibrant city centre, ensuring you are at the heart of York’s many attractions.

Ryedale House features a secure door entry system, ensuring safety and peace of mind, leading into a spacious and grand foyer, with the benefit of a concierge service.

Access to the apartment is facilitated by two lifts, plus a service lift, and additional staircase access, leading to spacious, well-lit, and impeccably presented communal hallways.

Situated with no apartment above, the apartment enjoys unparalleled privacy and tranquility.

The apartments private entrance opens into a welcoming and spacious hallway, with
engineered oak flooring, providing access to all rooms.

Within the hallway is a large fitted storage / cloakroom cupboard, and a large utility
cupboard. The communal hallway also offers access to a further good sized private storage space for the apartment together with a communal refuse shoot for general household and recycling waste. 

The sophisticated and contemporary living space offers seamless open plan living, creating a perfect space for entertaining. The stylish kitchen comes fully fitted with modern integrated appliances and boasts a large breakfast bar island. The dual aspect glass-to-glass corners offer wide scale views.

The master and second bedroom both feature fitted wardrobes and luxurious en-suite bathrooms. A third bedroom, also a generous double, offers flexibility for guests or a home office.

This apartment has the luxury of a further family bathroom. All bathrooms are fully tiled and fitted to a high standard, with automatic soft lighting.

The apartment benefits from an allocated undercover parking space in the secure gated car park, together with access to a secure communal bike store and external refuse area.

This exceptional property in Ryedale House offers spacious modern living at its finest, combining luxurious finishes such as underfloor heating, Envirovent ventilation and a sophisticated alarm system, with practical features to ensure a comfortable and secure lifestyle within the City Walls.
keyFeatures: Luxury Unique City Center Apartment with Concierge Service
Three Double Bedrooms & Open Plan Living
Allocated Undercover Parking in Secure Gated Car Park
Two En-Suite Shower Rooms & Additional Family Bathroom
